text: Every day that you get to wake up, it is a win.
I've had two traumatic brain injuries
and still very blessed to still be here
and still be functioning at a high level.
And that kind of really taught me
that life is such a blessing
and you can't take things for granted.
Every day that you get to wake up, it is a win.
So when you wake up being excited to be alive,
and make the most of the time that we get here.
And just, I refuse to not achieve things,
like go after my goals and put in the work.
